claim_boundary: Task-independent visual encoder controllability only; no full chart, score, training, or change to strict biology.

encoder.no_motion_rule: If current-minus-50ms screen displacement is not positive, return blank sensory input.
encoder.position_source: Current and past normalized rendered screen positions only; no note IDs, map schedule, target timestamp, judgment, or score.

task_free_controls: constant-speed countdown is nonincreasing and matches geometric time-to-contact within pixel quantization
after a velocity step, the estimator uses only the new trailing 50-ms window

frozen_policy_gate.pass: one DOWN within the inherited 73,500-us first-action window around receptor crossing; exactly one UP 10,000 us later; exact repeats; no action in untrained control; unchanged weights
